about: SYNTHETIC drift fixture (D2d). The layer STRUCTURE is invented to simulate one drift shape of an ArcGIS layer against the FL seed field map; every VALUE is derived from the FL golden county's recorded attributes (shared/landData/golden/fl-golden-county.json) by the ops in values.derive — no value is invented.
drift: AV_NSD renamed ASMT_NONSCHOOL whose alias is still 'AV_NSD'; values unchanged.
